title: The Rodeo Drive Suite Penthouse The Gulch
description:
Enjoy Nashville effortlessly & confidently in the perfect location…The Gulch! Carefully curated for people that have luxury and comfort in mind. Enjoy 5 star dining options, ample shopping, Nissan Stadium, Bridgestone Arena and more. Very walkable and close to everything that you may need. Sourced and strategically designed to elevate your experience and create a  sense of calmness and a serene environment that is bound to enhance your stay rather long term or short term stay.

The space
The space
We're all looking for venues that add value to our experience, and we believe our luxury space will do just that. The attention to detail and comfort are noticed throughout the apartment.

This apartment is located on the penthouse level on the 10th floor and is only a short walk/uber from Broadway, Ryman Auditorium, Bridgestone arena, Nissan Stadium, and the Convention Center. With two King Beds and one luxury air mattress this is a great space for a family or group of friends. 

The suite features 10' ceilings and over sized windows with views of the Nashville skyline, stainless steel appliances, and in-unit washer and dryer.

The New apartment complex acts as a hotel with endless amenities, including rooftop lounge (7th & 8th Floors), community pool (3rd floor), fire pits, smoker-style grills, private guarded paid parking space(s), community coffeehouse, state of the art fitness center (3rd floor), yoga room (3rd floor).

Lastly, please note that as our city grows, construction/train noise can be heard at times. 

STRP#2022074533

Guest access
Guest access

You'll have access to our entire apartment, as well as the courtyard, gym, rooftop lounge, etc. 

 *You’ll also have access to our resort style pool, but we are not responsible for maintenance delays and/or accidents that do happen around the pool that may require proper care for safety. No refunds will be given for Pool Closure*

One Key Fob will be issued during the stay

Other things to note
Parking

There is paid parking on the premises for your vehicle(s). The fee is 30 dollars per day per vehicle. That fee covers unlimited in and out privileges. Please provide me your license plate number, year, make, model, color, and state of license plate if you plan on having a vehicle(s) present. I have to manually update it in the system to avoid any parking issues. The community enforces a strong policy for unauthorized cars such as potential tickets, boot, or towing. 

The payment link will be sent to you prior to arrival. The vehicle information and payment must be sent in prior to your arrival.
